metadata.name: SearchBankAccount
metadata.description: To get bank account details of an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AccountNumber/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789654 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AccountNumber/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values:Valid Values: 1, 2, 3, 4 Example: 1= "Applicant", 2 ="Co-Applicant", 3= "Cosigner", 4 = Secondary Card Condition:Applicant Type is optional field. Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: BankAccountType
children.description: Type of Bank account added by customer for card payment,Checking Or Saving. Valid Values:Checking Or Saving Example:Saving Allowable Values: 30

children.name: BankName
children.description: Name of the Bank. Example:JPMorgan Chase Allowable Values: 100

children.name: BankRoutingNumber
children.description: Bank Rrouting number identifies the location of the bank's branch. Valid Values:111000038 Example: 111000038 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: MethodStatus
children.description: Payment Method Status for PreNote transaction. Possible Values 0 = Awaiting Validation 1 = PreNote Sent 2 = Validated 3 = Validation Rejected 4 = Deleted 5 = MicroDeposit Sent 6 = Active Valid Values:0,1,2,3,4,5,6 Example:0 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: MethodName
children.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account. This is required If User wants to send transaction in ACH. Valid Values:0-9 Example:4092 Allowable Values: 8

children.name: CreditBalanceRefund
children.description: Falg to describe credit balance refund,Only and Only one Bank Account can be 1 (Yes)  of an Account. Valid Values: Yes/No Example : Yes Allowable Values: 3

children.name: BAMLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digit of bank account number. Example: 2495 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: LoyaltyRedemptions
children.description: Whether Loyalty redemption is allowed on bank account or not. Possible values: 1=YES 0=NO Example:0,1 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: ApplicantType
children.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: Applicant/Co-Applicant/Cosigner Example: Applicant Allowable Values: 15

children.name: SuccessfulPaymentCounter
children.description: Indicates the counter of successful payments based on the Payment Hold logic definition set on product. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 3 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: UserIdCreated
children.description: ser ID of user created the bank account. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z

children.name: UserIdDeleted
children.description: ser ID of user created the bank account. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z

children.name: BankAccountDeletionDate
children.description: Date when bank account was deleted. Format:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:02/02/2020 12:00:00
